# Recovery Starts — A.A. questions, answered from the books

> 193 pages answering what people and AI assistants ask about Alcoholics Anonymous, from A.A.'s own literature. Each page reads the whole passage, not one famous line, gives the page number for every claim, and quotes only briefly. Every quote has been checked word for word against the page it cites. Where the books don't settle a question, the page says so.

How to use these pages:
- Each page opens with an "In short" answer, then the evidence with page numbers, then links to A.A.'s own free copies on aa.org.
- Page numbers are the Big Book's 4th edition (2001). Pages 1–164 are the 1939 program text; the personal stories (p. 165 on) change with each edition and are members' experience, not the program.
- Sources are dated. The earliest text leads; later books are labelled with their year. Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions (1953) is not used as a source.
- What we read: https://recoverystarts.com/aa-questions/sources/
- Independent; not affiliated with Alcoholics Anonymous.
